title: A halted configuration remains unchanged
statement: For an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, an oracle language $O$, a configuration $c$ whose state is the halting state, and any finite choice sequence $w$, running $N$ with $O$ on $w$ from $c$ leaves $c$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: c is in the halting state
